description: NaC₂PN₃HO₄H₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure consists of four H₂ clusters inside a NaC₂PN₃HO₄ framework. In each H₂ cluster, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one H atom. The H-H bond length is 0.75 Å. In the NaC₂PN₃HO₄ framework, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent PN₂O₂ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.60 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two N and one O atom. There is one shorter (1.34 Å) and one longer (1.42 Å) C-N bond length. The C-O bond length is 1.21 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two N and one O atom. There is one shorter (1.35 Å) and one longer (1.45 Å) C-N bond length. The C-O bond length is 1.23 Å. P is bonded to two N and two O atoms to form PN₂O₂ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (1.71 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) P-N bond length. Both P-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one C, one P, and one H atom. The N-H bond length is 1.03 Å. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two C atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one C and one P atom. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one N atom. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom.
